svg.aria-label: lesion-classifier-service: a terminal sends a skin-lesion photo to the API and gets back a JSON prediction with calibrated probabilities and a melanoma flag. Median latency 17 ms on 2 CPUs, about 58 requests per second, 21 tests, drift monitored.
